chain_words.nuance: having existed for a long time
belonging to a distant past era
belonging to an earlier period and no longer in ordinary use
existing from the very beginning of time

explanation: These words all describe something belonging to the past, from a merely outdated quality to something from the very beginning of time.

usage_notes.difference: 'Ancient' describes something from a distant historical period; 'archaic' describes language or style that survives from an earlier time but is no longer used.
